response.original_title: It’s Supposed to be Hard: An Arc of Attrition Story
response.overview: The story of Will’s attempt at The Arc of Attrition, one of the UK’s toughest ultramarathons. Watch as he pushes himself to the limit in this brutal 100-mile winter race, testing his physical and mental endurance. He shares how hybrid and endurance training have transformed his life, taking him from an unhappy, overweight teenager to potentially becoming the youngest-ever finisher of this infamous race.
